caption: The drawing depicts a single figurine of a woman standing on a plain, off-white background. The woman has dark skin and is dressed in a blue dress with an elbow-length sleeve and a white apron that covers the front of the dress; the apron has a yellow stain or spot near the center. She is wearing blue shoes and a red headscarf with white polka dots. Both of her hands rest on her hips. The figure features exaggerated facial features, including bright red lips. Near the lower right corner of the image, the name "R. CLARK" is stamped or written in capital letters. There are no other objects or embellishments in the composition.
title: Negro Mammy Bank
